hooks.name: check-before-done
hooks.description: Before the agent ends its turn: every module must parse and every test must pass. On failure the agent keeps working.

action.command: for f in $(find src -name '*.js'); do node --check "$f" || { echo "syntax error in $f" >&2; exit 1; }; done; npm test --silent > /tmp/rewind-tests.log 2>&1 || { tail -n 30 /tmp/rewind-tests.log >&2; exit 1; }
